Raj: low-key, just want to close it out 👍"},{"spec_id":"spec_0588","text":"Hey all, proposing a 60-min sync next Tues 10-11 with ops, carrier mgmt, WMS and CX leads on the Driftwood rollout. Flagging up front that the purpose is a bit fuzzy because the problem itself is fuzzy.

What we're seeing: dock-to-stock SLAs slipping at two DCs since cutover, OTIF down a few pts, and every team has a different root-cause hypothesis. Rosa thinks it's slotting logic in the new WMS config, Arjun's seeing carrier tender rejections spike on the LTL lanes, Carmen's CX queue says ASN mismatches. Gemma and Victor have floated rolling back wave planning entirely, which would have downstream impact on labor scheduling Hana owns.

We've tried async in the channel for a week and it keeps looping because each fix touches someone else's KPIs. I'd like everyone in the same room (virtual is fine) to walk the end-to-end flow, agree which levers are actually upstream, and land on whether we pause, patch, or push forward. Not a status meeting, please don't prep slides, bring data if you have it.

I know 17 is a lot. If you think your team is covered by someone else, tell me and I'll mark you optional. Otherwise invite going out tonight.

- Uma"},{"spec_id":"spec_0589","text":"Subject: Sr. Scientist req, decision Thu 3:00-3:30
